title: Peruvian Ceviche
description: A refreshing Peruvian dish made with raw fish marinated in citrus juices, mixed with onions and spices.

ingredients.name: Peruvian ceviche fish
ingredients.notes: Fresh catch of the day, preferably sea bass or halibut

ingredients.name: Fermented onions
ingredients.notes: Sliced and marinated in fermented juice

ingredients.name: Honeyed lime juice
ingredients.notes: Fresh lime juice mixed with a hint of honey

ingredients.name: Fish broth
ingredients.notes: Low-sodium broth for marinating the fish

ingredients.name: Aji amarillo peppers
ingredients.notes: Sliced and seeded for added flavor

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: For seasoning the fish and marinade

instructions: 1. Slice the fish into thin pieces and place in a shallow dish.
2. In a separate bowl, mix together the fermented onions, honeyed lime juice, fish broth, cilantro, and aji amarillo peppers.
3. Pour the marinade over the fish and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
4. Season with salt to taste and adjust the marinade as needed.
5. Serve the ceviche chilled, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
6. For an added crunch, garnish with toasted corn kernels or crispy plantain chips.
